These are distinct asset classes and accounting treatments.

The available candidates for AVGO focus on depreciation expense for tangible assets and lease expenses. Neither candidate addresses intangible assets or amortization of such assets, making them substantively incomparable to the target disclosure on intangible asset amortization.
